LanguageData.HH.Underworld.GateClosed: Not available in this game: the Underworld module is off, or the content intensity does not allow it (Settings, Modules).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.BackRoomDoorInfo: Only staff, colonists and shady guests can open this door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Titl: The back room was found out
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.BackRoomFound.Text: A respectable guest opened the wrong door and saw what the house keeps behind it. By evening everyone in town will know.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Title: Leaked ledger
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.LeakedLedger.Text: A page of the fence's tally has found its way into the wrong hands. The goods are traced back to your counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.SecretCasinoRumour: Word has gone round that your house hides a casino for people who do not talk about it. High rollers are looking for the door.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Scandal.HonourAmongThieves: A gang speaks well of your house in the places where it counts.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Animals.Desc: Animals of your colony may fight here.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Volunteers.Desc: From an older save: colonists with bloodlust or melee 8 and more also fight without being ticked under Fighters. Switch it off to let only the ticked colonists fight. Colonists never fight to the death.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Prisoners.Desc: Prisoners of the colony may fight here (adults only). The guards bring them into the arena and back to their cell.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Lethal.Desc: Bouts between prisoners and animals only end when one of them is down. Never for guests, colonists or slaves: their bouts are always fought for points.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.StartNow.Desc: Start a bout now: the sides picked under Fighters, or the two closest fighters. No guests needed, and the fairness limit does not apply.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.ArenaOpen: Arena open or too big: close the fence.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.BoutAnnounced: A bout in the pit: {0} against {1}. Bets are open.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Won: {0} wins the bout. The house keeps {1} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Draw: The bout ends without a winner. All stakes are returned.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Guests.Desc: Guests may fight here: shady guests and gang members always, other adult guests when they are not kind and have bloodlust, the brawler trait or melee 6 and more. Only guests who are awake, idle, healthy and staying a while. Their bouts are fought for points: nobody gets hurt, and a winning guest gets a small purse from the house take.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.FightersBtn.Desc: Everyone who could fight in this pit, why someone cannot fight now, which colonists fight here, and a bout you start yourself.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.CallOpponent.Desc: Hire a pit beast for a lone fighter: an animal about as strong as your fighter, brought into the arena for one bout and taken away afterwards. The till pays {0} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.WaitFighter: Waiting for a second fighter: tick a colonist under Fighters, allow prisoners, or call an opponent.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.WaitGuests: Waiting for guests to bet (you can start a bout yourself).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.AutoFailed: No automatic bout: {0}. Start a bout yourself or call an opponent.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.ArenaSmall: Arena too small: {0} tiles, at least {1} needed.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.ArenaBig: Arena open or larger than {0} tiles: close the fence around a smaller area.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.Off: The underworld is switched off (module or Cozy content).
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Status.Peaceful: Peaceful underworld is on: no fights.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.Won: {0} beat {1} in the pit. Pool {2} silver, house {3} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Result.Draw: {0} against {1}: no winner. All stakes are returned.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Why.NotGuest: not a guest of the house
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Why.NoTaste: does not want to: no taste for fighting
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Why.BeastThere: an opponent is already in the arena
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Why.NoLoneFighter: nobody to fight it: tick a colonist under Fighters
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Why.ArenaFull: no free tile in the arena
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.BeastNotYours: This animal is only hired for the fight pit.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Win.Title: Fighters of the pit
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Win.GroupOff: Off: switch on "{0}" on the marker.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Pit.Win.PickSides: Pick the sides, or leave "anyone suitable" for the closest match.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Inspect: Stock: {0} items worth {1} silver. Cash box: {2} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Fund.Desc: Move silver from the till into the fence's cash box, up to the limit in the settings.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Funded: {0} silver moved into the cash box.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Fence.Exposed: The goods came from {0}, and they know where they ended up.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Title: A gang at the door
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Text: {0} people from {1} arrive quietly, nod at the staff and ask for the back room. They have money and they expect no questions.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Title: A friendly offer
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Text: The leader of the gang from {0} leans on your counter. "A fine house. It would be a shame if something happened to it. For {1} silver we make sure nothing does."
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Tour.IntelText: After an hour with {0} the gang left a note on the counter: a name, a place, a day. Somebody out there is planning something, and now you know a little more.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Title: A crate at the dock
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.Text: A shuttle with its lights out has set down at the dock. A voice offers {0} items worth about {1} silver for {2}. No questions, no receipt.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Smuggler.InspectText: An imperial patrol saw the lights at your dock and has written it down.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Title: A hunting party
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Text: {0} hunters arrive with rifles and money. They paid {1} silver for the ground, and {2} animals were released into it.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.Prisoners.Desc: Let hunters hunt a prisoner released into the ground. Dark content only, with a fitting ideology.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.GatePrecept: The colony's ideology does not allow this.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathTitle: A person died in the hunt
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.DeathText: {0} did not survive the hunt. His people will hear of it, and so will everyone who was watching.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Hunt.FreedText: {0} lasted the time and walks free. The hunters went home angry; his faction will hear how it was done.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.Sold: {0} organs collected at the clinic counter.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderText: A buyer wants a {0} within {1} days and pays a premium.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderDone: The order for a {0} was filled.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Organ.OrderMissed: The order for a {0} was not filled in time.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Title: Underworld
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Weights: Arrival weights: respectable x{0}, outlaws x{1}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats1: Fight pit: {0} bouts, {1} bets, house take {2} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.Stats3: Lounge sessions {0}, gang visits {1}, landings {2}, hunts {3}, organs {4}.
LanguageData.HH.Underworld.Page.HighRollers: A rumour about a secret casino is drawing high rollers.
